Watts made this hymn from Psalm 87, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1He has founded His city on the holy mountains. 2The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob. 3Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah 4“I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’” … 3 more verses PSALM 87 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 87
